days6To15.title: UK Outlook for Saturday 21 Nov 2026 to Monday 30 Nov 2026

regional.headline: Unsettled with heavy rain and showers. Milder.

sections.title: Today:
sections.text: A wet and windy start on Tuesday with outbreaks of rain through the morning, sometimes heavy. Turning drier later with a scattering of showers and some bright spells. A milder day than yesterday, but breezy.

sections.title: Tonight:
sections.text: A few showers persisting this evening but most places dry. Further outbreaks of rain arriving overnight, turning heavy at times and milder than recent nights.

sections.text: Another mixed day with occasional sunny intervals and showers. These heavy at times, with the risk of thunder. Temperatures close to average.

sections.title: Outlook for Thursday to Saturday:
sections.text: Showery outbreaks of rain clearing through Thursday. Turning drier and brighter on Friday and into Saturday. Temperatures around average with frost overnight.
